nitrate-resonance.alt: Three Lewis diagrams of the nitrate ion joined by double-headed arrows, inside brackets with a minus charge. Each has N in the center bonded to three O atoms; the double bond is on the top O, then the lower left O, then the lower right O. N carries a +1 formal charge and each single-bonded O a −1. On the right, the hybrid shows each N–O bond as one solid and one dashed line, labeled every N–O bond is the same, bond order 4/3.
